title: Implement Dropout
hint: During training: randomly zero elements with probability p, scale survivors by 1/(1-p). During eval: identity. Use torch.rand_like and compare with p.

description.text: Implement dropout regularization as an nn.Module. During training, randomly zero elements with probability p and scale survivors by 1/(1-p). During eval, return the input unchanged.

examples.output: Roughly half zeros, remaining entries scaled by 2.0 (deterministic masks vary by run).
examples.explanation: Scaling keeps expected value equal to the identity when p > 0.

constraints: training mode: Bernoulli mask with keep probability (1 - p), scale by 1/(1-p).
eval mode: identity (no scaling, no masking).
Do not use nn.Dropout or F.dropout.
